## Description

Files transmitted through Windows-aware tools accumulate stray NUL bytes or `CR LF` line terminators. Naive scanners that only handle bare `\n` mis-count line numbers or misread tokens.

## Reproducer recipe

file with `CR LF` line endings throughout; or stray `\x00` bytes injected between tokens.

## Expected kernel behavior

ignore CR (treat as whitespace); skip stray NULs with a warning; emit accurate line numbers under either convention.

- allowed: `warn-and-proceed`
